## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Related Issue

Link the related Issue when one exists. A separate Issue is not required for
every small maintenance correction.

## Verification

List the checks that were actually run and their results. State any relevant
checks that could not be run locally.

## Impact

Describe user-facing, compatibility, installation, packaging, or release-note
impact. Write `None` when there is no such impact.

## Documentation

Describe the documentation changes, or explain why none are needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one coherent maintenance outcome.
- [ ] Relevant local verification has been run and reported above.
- [ ] User-facing workflows and supported behavior are documented when changed.
- [ ] No downloaded upstream archives, extracted vendor sources, build outputs,
      or generated files were committed unintentionally.
